channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula fala em 'escolha entre a verdade e a mentira' ato de campanha em Natal
item.description: During a campaign rally in Natal, President Lula framed the runoff as a choice between truth and lies, and endorsed Cadu de Lula, his running ally against Allyson Bezerra. He emphasized dialogue and responsible governance to overcome polarization.

item.title: Os números da disputa Flávio x Lula nas primeiras pesquisas do segundo turno
item.description: The first polls for the runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro show mixed scenarios, with three institutes favoring the senator and one, Vox, keeping the president within technical tie range. The race remains tight following the first round, where Flávio narrowly led Lula. The election is set for October 25th.

item.title: Rodrigo Simas grava participação em Quem Ama Cuida
item.description: Rodrigo Simas recorded his appearance in the telenovela 'Quem Ama Cuida' and expressed support for President Lula in the runoff elections, emphasizing the importance of a healthy democracy. He also pointed out the polarization of the moment and encouraged dialogue between different opinions. His wife, Agatha Moreira, is also part of the telenovela's cast.

item.title: Grupo Lide, de Doria, organiza almoço de empresários com Flávio
item.description: The Lide Group, led by João Doria, is organizing a lunch with entrepreneurs and Flávio Bolsonaro on October 19, six days before the presidential runoff. The event, at the W Hotel in São Paulo, will be a debate on the political and economic scenario. The relationship between Doria and the Bolsonaro family has been marked by misunderstandings, especially during the pandemic.

item.title: Ipespe: Flávio tem 52,7% dos votos válidos contra 47,3% de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leads the Ipespe poll against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the 2026 second-round election with 52.7% of valid votes versus 47.3%. Voting is scheduled for October 25th. Flávio's campaign shows better performance in TV and radio advertising according to 43% of respondents.

item.title: Flávio não será eleito para fazer um novo governo Bolsonaro
item.description: The article examines how Brazilian presidents, since 2010, misinterpreted election results, like Dilma Rousseff, who confused her victory with Lula's and later faced impeachment. Flávio Bolsonaro will not be elected to form a new government modeled after Jair Bolsonaro, repeating the pattern of misreading electoral signals.

item.title: Projeto prevê doação de excedentes de mercados a famílias vulneráveis
item.description: Senator Jader Barbalho (MDB-PA) proposes the Prato Farto Program to donate surplus market foods to vulnerable families, addressing food insecurity in Brazil. The bill establishes cooperation with companies without tax exemptions and will be funded by FNPC and voluntary donations. The initiative seeks to transform wasted food into social support through institutions such as food banks and community kitchens.

item.title: José de Abreu cobra colegas para que votem contra o “fascismo”
item.description: Actor José de Abreu released a video calling on entertainment colleagues such as Selton Mello, Giovanna Antonelli, and Carolina Dieckmann to take a stand against what he calls 'fascism' in Brazil, without necessarily supporting Lula or the PT directly. He emphasized the importance of artistic resistance and cited figures like Anitta and Ana Paula Renault as examples of non-partisan stances.

item.title: ‘Retratar VEJA como antilulista ou pró-Bolsonaro é uma piada’, diz Glenn Greenwald
item.description: Glenn Greenwald defends VEJA against accusations of being anti-Lula and pro-Bolsonaro, recalling the magazine's collaboration in covering the Vaza-Jato leaks and its criticism of Sergio Moro's conduct. He says attacks on media are predictable but ridiculous given the publication's track record.

item.title: Conheça as propostas de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro para a Cultura
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro propose different cultural policies focused on reducing regional concentration and improving incentives, but disagree on the state's role.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aposta em novos aliados, Michelle e vice para avançar no Nordeste
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro restructures his 2026 runoff campaign to gain ground on Lula in the Northeast, a region where he performed better than his father in 2022. With new alliances including Ronaldo Caiado and parties like Podemos and Republicanos, the candidate plans regional actions featuring Michelle Bolsonaro and running mate Alfredo Gaspar. The strategy aims to counter criticism and strengthen his image in one of the few areas where Lula won in the first round.

item.title: Poder e saber (por André Gustavo Stumpf)
item.description: Brazilian voters retired the 1988 generation of politicians, including figures like Sarney, Lula, Aécio Neves, and Marina Silva, leading to a major reconfiguration of the political landscape. Polling failures occurred, and a new cohort of politicians, many first-term legislators, will assume legislative power, reflecting a wave of renewal and a preference for less government and more private initiative.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest avalia propostas de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro: veja quais são
item.description: A new Quaest survey examines Brazilian opinions on campaign proposals from Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for the 2026 second-round elections, covering topics such as the end of the 6-for-1 work scale, amnesty for January 8 convicts, Supreme Court reforms, and the fight against organized crime.

item.title: Justiça italiana marca para o fim de outubro novo julgamento sobre extradição de Zambelli
item.description: The Italian judiciary has scheduled a new hearing for October 29 to reassess the extradition of former lawmaker Carla Zambelli, convicted in Brazil for armed stalking. The Italian court annulled the previous decision and requested additional guarantees regarding her health and prison treatment, dismissing the political persecution claim.

item.title: Aumentam agressões políticas em mês de luta contra violência à mulher
item.description: TSE data shows an 11-fold increase in political gender-based attacks between 2022 and 2026, rising from 15 to 177 cases, while human rights organizations recorded 134 incidents of political violence during the campaign leading up to the first round, with women being the primary victims. This context coincides with the National Day of Struggle Against Violence Against Women, established in memory of women who protested gender crimes in 1980.

item.title: Celina diz que PT politizou crise do BRB após União negar aval ao banco
item.description: Celina Leão (PP) accuses the PT of politicizing the Banco de Brasília (BRB) crisis after the federal government denied approval for a credit operation to the bank. In an interview with Rádio Atividade, she stated that she sought assistance from the federal government but was denied for ideological and political reasons. The case is at the Supreme Federal Court under the rapporteurship of Luiz Fux. The governor emphasized that she did not use lobbyists and criticized political opponents for publications that would harm the BRB liquidity.

item.title: Seja Flávio, Lula ou o papa eleito presidente, haverá um tesouraço no Brasil
item.description: The text analyzes Brazil's fiscal crisis and the lack of serious proposals from candidates, highlighting the risk of unpopular fiscal adjustments. It criticizes fiscal populism and recalls the 2015 austerity measures under Dilma Rousseff as an example of the consequences of discontinuous policies. It argues that the only real solution requires structural cuts, such as pension reform and adjustments to constitutional floors.

item.title: Bolsonaro logra el apoyo de tres perdedores y de varios partidos de derechas para la segunda vuelta
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro strengthens backing for the runoff after a tight first-round result. Candidates such as Augusto Cury, Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema, together with traditional right-wing parties, endorse him against Lula. The goal is to expand the base and counter progressive votes.

item.title: Flávio mira Lula com farsa desmentida na PF para abafar Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used a reportage disproven by PF and PGR to divert attention from the Vorcaro case, falsely accusing Lula. In audios, he was caught asking for money and using Vorcaro's jet during house arrest. According to the Noblat brothers, this is a cynical farce to silence the investigation.

item.title: A polarização ‘tóxica’ e a sedução da caricatura
item.description: The article examines how political polarization in Brazil, amplified by social media, pushes public figures toward extreme positions, leading to anxiety, depression, and hospitalizations. Drawing on concepts such as 'capture of life by politics' and 'caricature of the opponent,' it denounces the spread of fake news and pathetic narratives that dehumanize opponents, including unfounded accusations against Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: A reação de Janja quando sugeriram Ana Elisa na campanha de Lula: ‘Só se for para perder mesmo’
item.description: In a campaign meeting, a proposal to feature Congresswoman Ana Elisa in videos was rejected by First Lady Janja, who said 'Only if we really want to lose'. Later, the opposition unearthed the petista influencer's old posts with racial and political criticisms, worsening Lula's image.

item.title: Risco de derrota de Lula eleva a tensão no PT ao ampliar incertezas sobre futuro do partido
item.description: The possibility of Lula's defeat in 2026 heightens tensions within the PT, intensifying debates about who will succeed the historical leader of the party. With no viable candidate emerging, figures like Haddad, Gleisi and Boulos face recent electoral setbacks, revealing the left's fragility in rebuilding its base. The party needs to accelerate the renewal process to avoid a leadership vacuum post-Lula.

item.title: As ideias de Lula
item.description: The article criticizes Lula's and PT's economic ideas, highlighting disagreements over the state's role, privatizations and the independence of the Central Bank. It questions the left-wing stance on fiscal adjustment and public debt, warning of fiscal collapse risks.

item.title: Como Jair Bolsonaro quase conseguiu em 2022 a virada que Lula almeja no 2º turno
item.description: The article examines Jair Bolsonaro's 2022 strategy, achieving a 14% vote increase between rounds, outpacing Lula. For 2026, Lula must replicate this turnaround but faces obstacles like Flávio Bolsonaro's consolidated base and voter loss in Northeast.

item.title: ‘Onde dá pra conversar’: plataforma indica locais para virar votos para Lula
item.description: The 'Onde dá pra conversar' platform, created by data scientist Matheus Pestana, maps areas with high voter abstention and blank or null votes to help recover votes for President Lula in the 2026 election runoff. The strategy encourages direct voter outreach in everyday settings like bars and ride-sharing cars, and has been officially adopted by Lula's campaign.

item.title: A única capital da União Europeia onde Flávio Bolsonaro venceu o 1º turno
item.description: Athens is the only European capital where Flávio Bolsonaro won the first round, securing 46.6% of valid votes against Lula's 40%. This outcome is attributed to factors such as the lingering effects of Greece's economic crisis, a political landscape more receptive to far-right forces, and the significant presence of Brazilian evangelical churches in the city.

item.title: Cotado por Flávio para STF era 'distribuidor' de livros de Ustra entre bolsonaristas
item.description: Jorge Oliveira, a TCU minister, is considered for the STF in a hypothetical Flávio Bolsonaro government and helped spread the ideas of Colonel Ustra among Bolsonaro supporters.

item.title: Agenda de risco das empresas deixou perímetro financeiro e exige visão ampla
item.description: The risk agenda of Brazilian companies has expanded beyond the financial perimeter, encompassing strategic factors such as partner selection, technology, and logistics, under pressure from high interest rates, rising defaults, and the electoral political scenario. Regulatory changes, such as the repeal of mandatory sustainability reporting, reflect the uncertain environment faced by boards of directors.

item.title: Flávio e Lula têm disposições diferentes para debates no 2º turno e estratégias de ataque e defesa
item.description: Flávio e Lula têm disposições diferentes para debates no 2º turno e estratégias de ataque e defesa

item.title: Artistas podem impedir candidatos de usarem suas músicas? Entenda
item.description: The use of songs in electoral campaigns can generate controversies, such as the case of Frejat, who repudiated the use of 'Bete Balanço' in Renan Santos (MBL) campaign. Brazilian legislation allows the use of musical works in campaigns only with prior authorization from copyright holders, including composers and publishers. Parodies and adaptations also require legal attention, as not every lyric modification is considered legal.

item.title: Os redutos de Flávio e Lula em MG no 1º turno e onde tiveram menor votação
item.description: In the first round of the 2026 elections in Minas Gerais, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) received 5,777,548 votes, surpassing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), who got 5,188,936, with a margin of 588,612 votes. Lula had stronger support in Northern Minas and the Jequitinhonha Valley, while Flávio led in the South and Center-West. The most polarized municipalities include Guaraciama, where Lula reached 77.71% of the vote, and Monte Sião, where Flávio scored 74.66%.

item.title: Pauta do Senado, impeachment de Moraes é foco de deputado mais votado de SP
item.description: Lucas Pavanato (PL), the most-voted federal deputy in São Paulo, prioritizes the impeachment of Minister Alexandre de Moraes and limiting the powers of the Supreme Court. He also supports lowering the age of criminal responsibility, ending reelection, and reducing electoral populism.

item.title: Seleção Brasileira Feminina enfrenta Argentina em amistoso no Beira-Rio
item.description: The Brazilian Women's National Team begins its 2026 friendly schedule with matches against Argentina, including a game at the Beira-Rio Stadium. The team aims to build momentum after winning the FIFA Series title in April. Carol Gil was called up to replace Thais Ferreira to strengthen the squad.

item.title: A banda passou na janela e só Lula não viu
item.description: Lula blamed his first-round loss on inadequate communication to showcase his achievements, without considering that voters may have understood but rejected his legacy. His self-criticism avoids questioning whether public acceptance was truly a campaign issue.

item.title: Corra, Lula, corra
item.description: The article provides a political analysis focused on the upcoming runoff election, highlighting Lula as a candidate and criticizing his opponent for a history of corruption, unfulfilled promises, and divisive positions. It also discusses issues such as education, indigenous rights, representation, and social polarization, suggesting the opponent poses a risk to democracy.

item.title: O jogo dos sete erros do PT
item.description: The article analyzes the PT's potential strategy in the 2026 elections, suggesting the party may repeat similar mistakes from 2022 by underestimating the strength of candidates like Flávio Bolsonaro. It notes that the vote difference between Flávio and Lula in the first round resembles the margin that decided the previous election, indicating risks of repeating miscalculations.

item.title: Grupo de token pró-Flávio briga após prejuízos, cobra compradores e tira política de site até eleição
item.description: A pro-Bolsonaro token group behind the B22 cryptocurrency clashed after reporting financial losses. The asset's promoters and buyers are exchanging accusations and have decided to remove all political content from the website until the 2026 elections.

item.title: Dança das cadeiras: quais partidos ganharam e quais perderam espaço no Congresso Nacional
item.description: The 2026 elections reshaped congressional seats, with the PL expanding its caucus in the Chamber of Deputies (121 deputies) and the Senate (28 senators) to become the largest parliamentary force. Traditional parties like PSD, União Brasil, PSDB, and Cidadania (now without deputies) suffered major losses.

item.title: De desilusão com a política a viagens: abstenção nas eleições de 2026 é a maior desde 1998
item.description: Voter turnout in the 2026 elections dropped to 21.08%, the highest abstention rate since 1998, with 33 million eligible voters not participating in the first round. Voter apathy and political polarization between Lula and Bolsonaro were cited as key reasons, along with bureaucratic barriers and lack of accessibility.

item.title: Especialistas veem caráter eleitoreiro em medida do governo sobre combustíveis
item.description: With 16 days to the runoff, the Lula administration expanded fuel subsidies, eliminating PIS/Cofins and Cide taxes, giving consumers R$ 0,89 off per liter. Measures also cover diesel and ethanol, costing R$ 5,2 billion in public funds. Analysts see an electoral motive in the subsidy expansion.

item.title: TSE manda suspender site que oferece criptomoedas por apoio a Flávio
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court ordered the suspension of a website that offered cryptocurrencies in exchange for posts favoring presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, deeming it an economic advantage during the electoral period. The measure was proposed by Lula's campaign following a complaint to the Electoral Prosecutor's Office. Bolsonaro's campaign denied involvement and announced a lawsuit to take down the site.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro terá feriado com compromissos em SP e Brasília
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), candidate for reelection to the Presidency, will attend political and religious events in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and Brasília during the extended holiday of Our Lady of Aparecida, including a lunch with local officials and participation in religious celebrations.

item.title: Kassio baixa regra para acelerar análise de ações de propaganda no TSE após críticas
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques implemented rules to expedite analysis of electoral advertising before the second round. These changes aim to streamline processes and reduce criticism of the electoral judicial system.

item.title: Resultado da eleição redefine fila de cotados ao STF com Flávio Bolsonaro ou Lula
item.description: The 2026 election result reshaped the competition for the power to appoint justices to the STF (Supreme Federal Court), with either Flávio Bolsonaro or Lula emerging as potential presidential candidates. The winner will be able to reshape the court with at least four new appointments, influencing the lineup of candidates and responding to pressure for changes in the court's composition following the right-wing consolidation of a Senate majority.

item.title: Perfis pró-Flávio no Brasil e no exterior expuseram eleitores de Lula e incentivaram denúncias
item.description: Pro-Flávio Bolsonaro profiles in Brazil and abroad mobilized supporters to expose and encourage reports against overseas Lula voters during and after the first round of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Mobilização online pró-Lula liga alerta na campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro, que contra-ataca
item.description: Pro-Lula online mobilization raised alarms in Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, which retaliated with counter-offensives on WhatsApp. The digital confrontation intensified in the weeks leading up to the 2026 elections.

item.title: Favoritismo de Flávio Bolsonaro põe em xeque reeleição de Motta e Alcolumbre, e centrão se movimenta
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's favoritism within the PL party threatens the re-election of Hugo Motta and Davi Alcolumbre, as center-right parties compete for positions in the Chamber and Senate. The PL aims to take over at least one of the congressional chambers by February 2027.

item.title: Segundo turno tem guerra judicial com ordens de ministros contra Lula e ação do PT contra Flávio
item.description: The election race between Lula and Flávio Dino enters the final stretch of the second round with intense legal battles at the TSE, involving lawsuits and court orders against both candidates. The PT is also filing legal actions against Flávio, while the judiciary closely watches the campaigns.

item.title: Mulher de Flávio diz que “inventar mentiras” é diferente de discordar
item.description: Fernanda Bolsonaro defended her husband, Flávio Bolsonaro, on Instagram Stories, distinguishing democratic criticism from lies, and urged followers to check official campaign sources. She also shared personal details and promoted the 'Flávio com a Verdade' website.

item.title: Estela Aranha manda suspender site que oferece criptomoedas por apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE minister Estela Aranha ordered the suspension of a website that offered cryptocurrencies to users who supported Flávio Bolsonaro. Flávio's campaign denied involvement, claiming they were unaware of the site's authorship and vowed legal action. The case was reported by Lula's coalition to the TSE.
